text: Well well well, where do I begin. I don’t normally write reviews but when I have an experience like this I can’t help but put pen to paper. I entered McDonald’s a boy, by the time I came out I was due to collect my pension. Had about 15 minutes before my train and thought I would treat myself to a McDonalds, it is Halloween after all and I was dealt a nasty trick instead. 15 minutes went by and that gorm behind the till still hadn’t moved an inch. Bye bye train, don’t worry I’ll just get the next one. Hahahaah how wrong was I. 30 minutes goes by and I’m still waiting for one measly wrap, I don’t even want it anymore. At least the two girls behind the bar were having a good chinwag while the rest of us common folk waited in purgatory. After 35 minutes pass, I finally hear something unusual, the sound of a McDonald’s worker calling out a number!!! My number to be exact. Giving me just enough time to sprint for the third train and eat my McDonalds nursing a stitch and a sweaty brow. And to top it off, when I finally took a bite, of course my food was colder than Santa Claus during a power cut. Alas! A pube in my wrap! I don’t know which erchin placed it there, but I know it was no mistake. So to wrap it up, probably wouldn’t go again.
author: Joe Lee

text:
I am a delivery rider and was prevented from collecting orders that were fully available on both my Uber Eats and Deliveroo apps.

As a self-employed rider, the contractual rules clearly state that I am allowed to work with multiple apps simultaneously. However, the McDonald’s team refused to release the orders, forcing me to cancel them.

I even asked the shift manager to show me any document stating that I was not allowed to do this. None was presented, because no such rule exists. Deliveroo support was contacted, but Uber Eats support was ignored.

This incident not only caused me financial loss but also showed a lack of respect for riders who work hard and professionally. Riders already wait up to 20 minutes for orders in this branch while staff show little urgency.

A very disappointing and unprofessional experience.
author: Isabela Carmo

text: I bought a total of three ice creams, the clerk only made two and told me to wait for the next one, but by the time he finished the third one the first two had melted and I had to ask for them to be replaced, the manager came over and accused me of not listening to the clerk's call, I told the manager the clerk hadn't warned me at all and it was only because I had paid attention to the number on the screen that I had gone to get my ice creams and they eventually gave them to me! They remade it, but the portion was very small and in terrible shape (top right and bottom left). I ended up reaping the rewards of their impatient cocky service, and badly shaped little ice creams, and wasting my emotions, too bad!
author: yuheng zhang

text: Absolutely horrendous experience, me and my son went for a trip in Brighton and we went into McDonald's for some lunch. We were shocked to see that a spider was inside of my sons big mac Bacon burger. We then went to speak to a member of staff and instead of them actually helping they decided to start laughing and taking the mick. We showed proof that we were being serious and yet they didnt do anything about it and walked off. This made me lose 16 pound and we didn't even get to eat anything. This has really upset me and my son as it was meant for a nice day out. Absolutely ridiculous we will not be going back again

text: This morning I went to the London Road Amac. We spent more than 30 minutes waiting for our order, which was already ready, and they just talked. The manager is called Kim, I spoke to her and she told me that one day it takes 2 minutes and the other more than 30 and that this is normal. I asked for the name of a employee because I was going to make a complaint, they refused to give his name and the employee didn't have a badge. This manager spends her time covering up and doesn't solve the problems.

text: I have a complaint about delivery orders. Positions disappear regularly. There is a position on the sticker on the package, but it is not in the package. Happens 5 times already. If anyone cares, you can check today's E9EAD order. Didn't include Bacon Double Cheese. The delivery service is not responding. My several requests for a refund for missing items were approved, but the money never came. I understand that McDonald's is a big company. But this is too much...

text: My son ordered a meal for delivery. The main item wasn't there when he opened the bag. The time before that he was told his food had been delivered when it hadn't even arrived. I'm never going to get this money back so I am encouraging everyone I know to boycott

Won’t be ordering again, absolute joke!
